description: Compares depth-stratum sums Σ_{depth(λ)=k} y_λ in σ-convention (my y_λ from witness) vs g-convention (Wenzl Schur-element formula at Q=q², r solved from z_GL=q·z_my). Tests whether the GB filtration is a gauge-invariant structure (yes by construction; y_λ values differ but stratum partition is identical) — and whether stratum-sum ratios are constant across n.
